title: Trump's Antisemitism Envoy Grilled
body: Rabbi Yehuda Kaploun, Trump's nominee for US Special Envoy for Combating Antisemitism, faced a contentious Senate hearing. He was joined by five other nominees for ambassador-level posts. The hearing was part of the standard process for high-level government appointments.

title: UTJ Opposes Dairy Reform
body: United Torah Judaism faction opposes Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich's dairy sector reform, claiming it hurts local producers and will raise prices.
